implemented: Android JavaScript editor calls HeroNativeRuntime through the existing Java bridge
HeroNativeRuntime invokes the C++ timeline engine directly through JNI; no Java ProcessBuilder renderer process
C++ timeline engine is linked into libhero_runtime.so by Android CMake
C++ engine owns project/source staging, timeline rendering, output probing and verification
FFmpeg and FFprobe are packaged as Android PIE executables in nativeLibraryDir and invoked by absolute path
verified output is saved through Android MediaStore
no arbitrary 25-track schema/UI cap; no forced stereo layout conversion
Android JS bridge unwraps JNI JSON-RPC result envelopes and propagates native error messages
known_limitations: Android NDK build, APK packaging and physical-device rendering are not yet verified
FFmpeg build profile excludes GPL/nonfree codec libraries; unavailable codecs fail explicitly
native render progress stream and cancellation not implemented
Android FFmpeg/FFprobe PIE executables are built during the NDK build and are not prebuilt in the source ZIP; physical-device execution is not verified
